examples.en: The post-incident review is scheduled within five working days.
examples.zh: 事故后评审安排在五个工作日之内。

situation.en: Ground rules for the post-incident review: timeline first, opinions after.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 事故后评审（复盘的正式说法）

examples.en: The incident timeline is built from logs, not from memory.
examples.zh: 事故时间线是从日志里拼出来的，不是靠回忆。

situation.en: The incident timeline below uses UTC throughout.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 事故时间线（按分钟还原的过程）

examples.en: The timeline of events shows a nine-minute detection gap.
examples.zh: 事件时间线显示检测环节有九分钟空白。

situation.en: Attach the timeline of events to the ticket so support can reuse it.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 事件时间线（同时间线的另一种说法）

examples.en: The impact summary leads the document, above the technical detail.
examples.zh: 影响概述写在文档最前面，技术细节在后面。

situation.en: Impact summary: checkout errors for forty minutes, no data loss.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 影响概述（复盘开头交代后果）

examples.en: Customer impact was limited to delayed reports, not lost data.
examples.zh: 客户影响仅限于报表延迟，没有丢数据。

situation.en: State customer impact plainly before explaining internals.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 客户影响（用户实际受了什么影响）

examples.en: The duration of outage was forty-three minutes, door to door.
examples.zh: 故障时长总共四十三分钟，从头到尾。

situation.en: Report the duration of outage honestly; rounding it down helps nobody.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 故障时长（从开始到恢复的总时长）

examples.en: The detection gap was longer than the fix itself.
examples.zh: 检测空白比修复本身还要久。

situation.en: Closing the detection gap is the highest-value follow-up here.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 检测空白（故障发生到被发现的间隔）

examples.en: Time to detect was nine minutes; the budget says two.
examples.zh: 检测耗时是九分钟；预算是两分钟。

situation.en: Our time to detect improved only after symptom-based alerts.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 检测耗时（故障到发现用了多久）

examples.en: Time to mitigate was short because the rollback was rehearsed.
examples.zh: 缓解耗时很短，因为回滚演练过。

situation.en: Separate time to mitigate from time to fully resolve in the writeup.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 缓解耗时（发现到止血用了多久）

examples.en: Time to resolve stretched to three hours on data backfill.
examples.zh: 解决耗时拖到了三小时，卡在数据回填上。

situation.en: Time to resolve matters less than whether users noticed.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 解决耗时（发现到彻底恢复用了多久）

examples.en: Root cause analysis follows the evidence chain, not the loudest theory.
examples.zh: 根本原因分析跟着证据链走，不跟着嗓门最大的理论走。

situation.en: The root cause analysis section separates cause from contributing factors.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 根本原因分析（复盘的核心动作）

examples.en: The five whys took us from a timeout to a missing review step.
examples.zh: 五个为什么把我们从一个超时带到一个缺失的评审环节。

situation.en: Run the five whys on the process, not on the person.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 五个为什么（连问五次为什么的挖根法）

examples.en: The triggering change was a routine config push at 14:02.
examples.zh: 触发变更是 14:02 的一次例行配置推送。

situation.en: Identifying the triggering change is step one; it is not yet the root cause.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 触发变更（引爆故障的那次改动）

examples.en: The change that introduced it shipped three weeks before it fired.
examples.zh: 引入问题的那次变更在爆发前三周就上线了。

situation.en: Bisecting releases found the change that introduced it within an hour.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 引入问题的那次变更

examples.en: The missed signal was a slow rise in queue depth all morning.
examples.zh: 被错过的信号是整个上午缓慢上升的队列深度。

situation.en: Every incident has a missed signal; the review's job is to name it.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 被错过的信号（事前其实有征兆）

examples.en: The monitoring gap sat exactly where the failure started.
examples.zh: 监控缺口正好在故障开始的地方。

situation.en: Fixing the monitoring gap is action item one.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 监控缺口（该有监控而没有）

examples.en: The runbook gap forced the on-call to improvise the rollback.
examples.zh: 手册缺口迫使值班同事对回滚步骤临场发挥。

situation.en: A runbook gap is a process bug, not an operator error.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 手册缺口（手册没写清的环节）

examples.en: Each follow-up action needs an owner before the meeting ends.
examples.zh: 每个跟进行动都必须在散会前有负责人。

situation.en: The follow-up action list is short on purpose: five items, all dated.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 跟进行动（复盘后要做的改进项）

examples.en: The preventive measure is a contract test between the two services.
examples.zh: 预防措施是两个服务之间的契约测试。

situation.en: A preventive measure that needs heroics will not survive the quarter.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 预防措施（防复发的手段）

examples.en: The corrective action shipped the following week.
examples.zh: 纠正措施在接下来的一周内上线了。

situation.en: Distinguish the corrective action from the preventive one in the writeup.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 纠正措施（针对已发生问题的修复动作）

examples.en: The detection improvement is an alert on queue depth, not CPU.
examples.zh: 检测改进是给队列深度加告警，而不是 CPU。

situation.en: Detection improvement items close the gap named in the timeline.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 检测改进（让下次更早发现）

examples.en: The blast radius summary counts affected tenants, not requests.
examples.zh: 影响范围概述统计的是受影响的租户数，不是请求数。

situation.en: Lead with the blast radius summary; executives read nothing else first.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 影响范围概述（到底波及了多少）

examples.en: Lessons learned go in the team wiki the same week.
examples.zh: 经验教训在同一周内进团队知识库。

situation.en: The lessons learned section is three bullets, not thirteen.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 经验教训（复盘的沉淀小节）

examples.en: Under what went well: the rollback worked exactly as rehearsed.
examples.zh: “做得好的地方”里写：回滚完全按演练的样子工作了。

situation.en: What went well matters; it tells you which habits to protect.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 做得好的地方（复盘的固定小节）

examples.en: What went poorly: two teams paged the same database engineer.
examples.zh: 做得差的地方：两个团队呼叫了同一个数据库工程师。

situation.en: Be specific in what went poorly: name the step, not the person.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 做得差的地方（复盘的固定小节）

examples.en: Where we got lucky: the bad deploy landed before peak traffic.
examples.zh: 我们走运的地方：坏版本是在流量高峰之前上线的。

situation.en: Where we got lucky is the most honest section of any review.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 我们走运的地方（差点更糟的环节）

examples.en: Every line names an action item owner and a date.
examples.zh: 每一行都写了行动项负责人和日期。

situation.en: An item without an action item owner is a wish, not a plan.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 行动项负责人（每个改进项的名字）

examples.en: The due date for the fix is the end of this sprint.
examples.zh: 修复截止日期是这个迭代结束前。

situation.en: Set the due date for the fix in the review, not in a later thread.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 修复截止日期

examples.en: We share the writeup with support before the customer call.
examples.zh: 我们会在和客户通话之前把复盘稿分享给支持团队。

situation.en: Share the writeup widely inside the company; hide only customer data.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 分享复盘稿（发给干系人看）

examples.en: Sanitize the details before the summary leaves the company.
examples.zh: 在摘要发到公司外部之前，先做脱敏处理。

situation.en: Legal asked us to sanitize the details about the affected accounts.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 脱敏处理（发外部前去掉敏感信息）

examples.en: A blameless writeup describes actions and systems, not culprits.
examples.zh: 无指责复盘稿描述动作和系统，不写罪人。

situation.en: Keep it a blameless writeup: the timeline carries the facts.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 无指责复盘稿（写系统不写人）

examples.en: The executive summary of the incident fits on one screen.
examples.zh: 事故高管摘要一屏就能放下。

situation.en: Write the executive summary of the incident last, but place it first.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 事故高管摘要（给管理层的一页纸）

examples.en: Severity classification follows customer impact, not internal effort.
examples.zh: 等级划分看客户影响，不看内部忙乱程度。

situation.en: Our severity classification was argued for ten minutes; the matrix settles it now.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 等级划分（事故定级的做法）

examples.en: Declare the incident early; you can always stand it down.
examples.zh: 事故要早宣告；随时可以解除。

situation.en: The on-call waited forty minutes to declare the incident, and that delay is on us.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 宣告事故（正式拉响事故流程）

examples.en: We stand down once error rates stay normal for thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 错误率正常保持三十分钟后，我们解除事故状态。

situation.en: The commander will stand down the bridge at the top of the hour.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 解除事故状态（宣布恢复正常）

examples.en: The all-clear message goes to the same channels as the alert.
examples.zh: 解除警报消息要发到和警报相同的频道里。

situation.en: Send the all-clear message even if the thread has gone quiet.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 解除警报消息（告诉大家恢复了）

examples.en: A status page update is owed every thirty minutes during an incident.
examples.zh: 事故期间每三十分钟欠用户一次状态页更新。

situation.en: The status page update said 'investigating' for two hours; that was our failure.
situation.zh: 复盘评审会上你这样说：

entries.zh: 状态页更新（对外同步进展）

examples.en: The customer communication draft avoids internal jargon entirely.
examples.zh: 客户沟通稿完全不用内部术语。

situation.en: Legal reviews the customer communication draft before it goes out.
situation.zh: 你在写事故复盘，这样落笔：

entries.zh: 客户沟通稿（对外说明的草稿）
